name: VIX + SPY Market Filter (Master)
description: Global market regime filter combining VIX fear index with SPY trend. Applied before every scan to gate trade execution. NOT a per-stock entry strategy.

HEALTHY.label: ✅ STRONG — full position size (100%)
HEALTHY.action: Trade normally at full position size

WEAK.label: ⚠️ NEUTRAL — reduced position size (50%)
conditions: SPY mixed signals (not clearly above/below SMA20)

VERY_WEAK.label: ⛔ WEAK — no new trades
conditions: SPY < SMA20 by 2%+ OR SPY daily change ≤ -2%
VERY_WEAK.action: Block all new trade entries to protect capital

notes: VIX alone is not sufficient — combine with SPY trend
Example: VIX low but SPY falling → still WEAK
Fail-open: if VIX data unavailable, SPY-only logic applies
Each VIX + SPY fetch costs 1 API call (12.5s sleep between them on free tier)
